work.title: Floydband Burped and Puked
work.description: Mixed-media collage featuring a central photographic scene of figures surrounding mannequin heads, overlaid with iridescent rainbow lettering spelling 'FLOYDBAND' and handwritten psychedelic text reading 'Burped and Puke Game All My Nose.' Three-dimensional cut-out letters spelling 'FLOYDBAND' appear on the left spine against a hot-pink ground.
work.composition: central photographic inset flanked by 3D lettering
